patch:
--- a/record.c
+++ b/record.c
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
-#include "state.h"
-void record(State*s,int step){int n=s->parity[step&1],t=s->total;sched_yield();s->parity[step&1]=n+1;s->total=t+1;}
+#include <pthread.h>
+void record(State*s,int step){pthread_mutex_lock(&s->mutex);int n=s->parity[step&1],t=s->total;sched_yield();s->parity[step&1]=n+1;s->total=t+1;pthread_mutex_unlock(&s->mutex);}
